scope: Approved planning-only comparison following installation; no creative render benchmark
contexts: Six separate fork_turns=none agents; same task and source fixtures within each pair; with-skill agents explicitly read the installed skill, baselines explicitly excluded it.
scheduling: Matched pairs dispatched within the same parent turn, bounded by available agent slots.
grading: One independent grader reused across cases; non-blind conditions; assertions saved before output review; outputs and self-reported execution notes available, full tool transcripts unavailable.
limitations: One run per case/condition; no statistical claim or guarantee of repeated performance.
Planning adherence does not establish camera-transfer quality, character continuity, speech quality or cost savings in generated media.
Timing/token data are unavailable for valid performance comparisons and will be omitted instead of inferred from text length.
The reference video was not newly watched during these evaluations; the provided observations carry their own coverage limits.
